shortDescription: Allows operations with IONOS CLOUD VM Autoscaling Groups.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: The zone where the VMs are created. The availability zone is always automatically set to 'AUTO' for performance reasons. Even if you set another value, e.g. 'null', or leave it empty.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: cores
options.description: The total number of cores for the VMs.

options.name: cpu_family
options.description: The CPU family for the VMs created with this configuration. If the value is 'null', the VM is created with the default CPU family for the assigned site.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The VMs for this VM Auto Scaling Description are created in this virtual data center.

options.name: do_not_replace
options.description: Boolean indicating if the resource should not be recreated when the state cannot be reached in another way. This may be used to prevent resources from being deleted from specifying a differentvalue to an immutable property. An error will be thrown instead

options.name: max_replica_count
options.description: The maximum value for the number of replicas for 'targetReplicaCount'. Must be >= 0 and <= 200. Will be enforced for both automatic and manual changes.

options.name: metric
options.description: The metric that triggers the scaling actions. Metric values are checked at fixed intervals.

options.name: min_replica_count
options.description: The minimum value for the number of replicas for 'targetReplicaCount'. Must be >= 0 and <= 200. Will be enforced for both automatic and manual changes

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the VM Auto Scaling Group. This field must not be null or blank.

options.name: nics
options.description: The list of NICs associated with this replica.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: ram
options.description: The size of the memory for the VMs in MB. The size must be in multiples of 256 MB, with a minimum of 256 MB; if you set 'ramHotPlug=TRUE', you must use at least 1024 MB. If you set the RAM size to more than 240 GB, 'ramHotPlug=FALSE' is fixed.

options.name: range
options.description: Specifies the time range for which the samples are to be aggregated. Must be >= 2 minutes.

options.name: scale_in_action
options.description: Defines the action to be taken when the 'scaleInThreshold' is exceeded. Here, scaling is always about removing VMs associated with this VM Auto Scaling Group. By default, the termination policy is 'OLDEST_SERVER_FIRST' is effective.

options.name: scale_in_threshold
options.description: The lower threshold for the value of the 'metric'. Used with the `less than` (<) operator. When this value is exceeded, a scale-in action is triggered, specified by the 'scaleInAction' property. The value must have a higher minimum delta to the 'scaleOutThreshold', depending on the 'metric', to avoid competing for actions at the same time.

options.name: scale_out_action
options.description: Defines the action to be performed when the 'scaleOutThreshold' is exceeded. Here, scaling is always about adding new VMs to this VM Auto Scaling Group.

options.name: scale_out_threshold
options.description: The upper threshold for the value of the 'metric'. Used with the 'greater than' (>) operator. A scale-out action is triggered when this value is exceeded, specified by the 'scaleOutAction' property. The value must have a lower minimum delta to the 'scaleInThreshold', depending on the metric, to avoid competing for actions simultaneously. If 'properties.policy.unit=TOTAL', a value >= 40 must be chosen.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: unit
options.description: The units of the applied metric. 'TOTAL' can only be combined with 'INSTANCE_CPU_UTILIZATION_AVERAGE'.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: vm_autoscaling_group
options.description: The ID or name of an existing VM Autoscaling Group.

options.name: volumes
options.description: List of volumes associated with this Replica.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
